name: WF-312 — Underwriting Calibration → Dynamic MAO & Deal Strategy Adjustment

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deal=input.deal??input; const calibration=input.calibration??deal.calibration??{}; const baseMao=Number(deal.base_mao??deal.mao??deal.max_allowable_offer); const factor=Number(calibration.adjustment_factor??1); const confidence=String(calibration.confidence??'low').toLowerCase(); const assetType=String(calibration.asset_type??deal.asset_type??deal.property_type??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const dealType=String(calibration.deal_type??deal.deal_type??'wholesale').toLowerCase(); const blockers=Array.isArray(deal.blockers)?deal.blockers:[]; const validBase=Number.isFinite(baseMao)&&baseMao>=0; const validFactor=Number.isFinite(factor)&&factor>0; const adjustedMao=validBase&&validFactor?Math.round(baseMao*factor*100)/100:null; const strategy=assetType.includes('land')?'land_specific_economics':assetType.includes('multi')||dealType.includes('multifamily')?'multifamily_specific_economics':'residential_wholesale_economics'; const status=blockers.length?'blocked':!validBase?'incomplete':!validFactor?'invalid_calibration':'low'===confidence?'human_review_required':'strategy_adjusted'; const dynamicMao={base_mao:baseMao,adjustment_factor:factor,adjusted_mao:adjustedMao,confidence,asset_type:assetType,deal_type:dealType,strategy,ma_rule:'secondary_reference_only',economics_priority:'asset_specific_first'}; return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-312',workflow_name:'Underwriting Calibration → Dynamic MAO & Deal Strategy Adjustment',status,dynamic_mao:dynamicMao,adjusted_mao:adjustedMao,next_workflow:status==='strategy_adjusted'?'WF-313':status==='human_review_required'?'WF-126':status==='blocked'?'WF-126':'WF-311',crm_activity:{activity_type:'dynamic_mao_strategy_adjustment',deal_id:deal.deal_id??deal.id,status,dynamic_mao:dynamicMao}}}];
